en.title: Four-Digit Codes with Digit Sum S
en.description:
Four-digit codes range from 0000 to 9999, and leading zeros are allowed. Given S, count the codes whose four digits sum to S.

The input format, examples, and test data are compiled and written by CSWork.
en.output: Output the answer as described; multiple results are separated by spaces, in order.
en.explanation: The example inputs and outputs follow the rules above directly; see the solution for the full algorithm.
hints: dp[s] records how many ways there are to reach digit sum s after filling in some digits. For each new digit, move every old state to the states obtained by adding a digit 0..9.
